claims.quote: Our observation of a STX1B deletion in a third patient with MAE therefore supports that STX1B gene variants or deletions can be involved in the aetiology of MAE.
This deletion results in haploinsufficiency of STX1B and other genes.
Haploinsufficiency of the STX1B gene is associated with myoclonic astatic epilepsy.
